text:
At 17, This Actress Became The Fourth Wife Of A 48-Year-Old Actor - Regretted It All Her Life
Curated By :
Last Updated:
This Southern cinema heroine, once a child artist, tied the knot at 17 with a 48-year-old actor, a marriage marked by betrayal that turned her life upside down
Advertisement
1/7
Anju, who first captured hearts as a child artist in Tamil cinema, became a cherished figure in Malayalam films, where audiences embraced her as one of their own. A protégé of the legendary director Mahendran, her promising career took a dramatic turn at just 17, when she married a 48-year-old actor, older than her own father, altering the course of her life forever.
Advertisement
2/7
Anju made her debut as a child artist in Mahendran’s Tamil classic Uthiri Pookkal, a film that remains iconic to this day. Over her career, she appeared in more than 40 films across Malayalam, Tamil, and Telugu cinema. While she often played child roles, she also took on leading roles in several films.
3/7
Her performances in movies such as Rajinikanth’s Polladhavan, Kamal Haasan’s Meendum Kokila, Bhagyaraj's Darling Darling Darling, and other films like Azhagiya Kanne, Keladi Kanmani, and Arangetra Velai brought her widespread recognition. In Malayalam cinema, she starred opposite legends like Mammootty and Mohanlal, including playing Mammootty’s daughter in Aa Rathri, a role that drew significant criticism. She also played the lead in Mammootty’s Kauravar.
Advertisement
4/7
Anju’s husband, Kannada actor Tiger Prabhakar, was a prominent figure in Kannada, Malayalam, Tamil, and Hindi cinema. He is also remembered for his role as a police officer in Rajinikanth’s Muthu.
5/7
However, Anju's marriage at just 17 to the 48-year-old Tiger Prabhakar brought immense personal hardship. “I was 17 then. It can't be called a marriage. I was with him for a year and a half. A child was born. Three months later, I discovered his extramarital affair. Bigger problems arose after that. I was his fourth wife, and I didn’t know it. I left, saying I won’t listen to you anymore,” Anju revealed.
Advertisement
6/7
She later discovered that Tiger Prabhakar already had three children, all older than her. When she confronted him about their child, he shockingly claimed the child was not his, adding to her distress. “I told him right there that I hated him. I said I would never talk to him again and left,” she said.
